tagline: Structured felt walls that stay standing when your dog leans their weight on them.
lead: Your dog gets a nest with walls that stay up when they lean on them, not sides that fold flat.
value: A wall that stays up is the whole point of a nest bed. Structured felt keeps these sides standing on their own.
intro: Dove is a nest dog bed built in structured felt, with padded high sides and a cushioned base inside a properly enclosed nest shape. Small, Medium and Large.
points: They stand up on their own instead of flopping outward.
Firm enough to lean on, padded where they rest against them.
Soft underfoot inside a defined, nest-shaped sleeping space.
best_for: Dogs who curl up and lean into the side of their bed, and homes tired of nest walls that collapse.
fit_note: The structured walls take up a good part of the outside measurements, so measure your dog curled up and size up if you're between sizes. Not sure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Follow the sewn-in care label and air-dry. Do not machine wash the felt structure.
seo_title: Felt Nest Dog Bed with Structured High Sides | Snoozly
seo_description: A felt nest dog bed whose structured walls stay standing when your dog leans on them. Padded high sides and a cushioned base. Small, Medium and Large.
